events.content:
I can see the issue. The product page (`app/product/page.tsx:3`) calls `getInventory()` which uses `await connection()` from `next/server` (lib/data.ts:4). This makes the entire route dynamic, so nothing streams until that call resolves.

With `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`, the fix is to split the page: keep the static title in the shell and wrap the dynamic inventory data in a `<Suspense>` boundary so it can stream in.
